en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town street by a bridge. On the left are gabled houses with tiled roofs and climbing plants on the façades; on the right is a metal railing of a bridge and a large tree. Several pedestrians, including women in early 20th‑century dress, walk along the street toward the camera. Printed German captions appear at the top and bottom of the image.
